title: Per-mechanism identifiability ledger over metamorphic pairs
description: Closed-object schema for the load-bearing per-mechanism identifiability ledger emitted by `tools/metamorphic_pairs/` after the pre-registration freeze tag has been applied. The ledger reports, for each `(mechanism, kernel)` cell, a typed verdict: whether the measured fingerprint difference between the paired shapes `P_a` and `P_b` is statistically distinguishable per the pre-registered effect-size threshold combined with multiple-comparison correction; whether the predicted fingerprint difference matches in sign and approximate magnitude; and whether the cell is `inconclusive_undersampled` because the pre-roster power analysis did not establish the minimum detectable effect at this cell. Negative-control pairs (predicted indistinguishable) are admitted into the ledger as integrity checks; a negative-control pair reported as `identifiable_at_threshold` flags the entire ledger with `negative_control_failed` and the mechanism panel cannot be trusted.

ledger_id.description: Stable identifier for this ledger emission. Generated at emission time; unique per ledger commit.

mechanism_panel_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the pre-registered mechanism panel TOML enumerating the mechanisms this ledger reports on. Frozen pre-registration artifact.

power_analysis_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the pre-roster power-analysis report establishing per-mechanism minimum detectable effect. Frozen pre-registration artifact.

mechanism_confusion_matrix_ref.description: Repo-relative path to `mechanism_confusion_matrix.toml` enumerating which mechanism pairs are expected separable / ambiguous / impossible under counter-free observables. Frozen pre-registration artifact.

mcc_method.description: Multiple-comparison correction method applied per cell. Frozen at pre-registration time; emitting a verdict before the MCC primitive is registered triggers `identifiability_ledger_emitted_without_mcc`.

ledger_status.description: Aggregate ledger status. `negative_control_failed` is set when at least one negative-control pair is reported as `identifiable_at_threshold`; the mechanism panel cannot be trusted in that case. `ledger_emitted_without_mcc` is set when the ledger was emitted before the multiple-comparison-correction primitive was registered in the metric framework.

mechanism_id.description: Stable identifier for the mechanism this cell isolates (e.g. `gto_scheduler`, `l1_sector_model`, `mshr_coalescing`, `mma_sync_per_precision_latency`, `shared_atomic_conflict_resolution`, `cluster_barrier`).

data_provenance.description: Provenance class for this cell. Synthetic cells validate the gate software end-to-end; only measured cells carry scientific identifiability claims.

verdict.description: Per-cell typed verdict. `not_identifiable` is a first-class scientific result delineating the boundary of counter-free identifiability, NOT a failure. `inconclusive_undersampled` indicates the pre-roster minimum-detectable-effect was not satisfied for this cell; the cell remains in the ledger surfaced explicitly rather than being scoped out.

effect_size.description: Measured effect size for the (mechanism, kernel) cell, in fingerprint-difference units defined by the per-axis distance metric registered in the metric framework.

n_pairs.description: Number of metamorphic pairs contributing to this cell's statistic. Must satisfy the per-mechanism sample-size requirement from the pre-roster power analysis.

is_negative_control.description: True iff this cell is a negative-control pair. Negative-control pairs are predicted indistinguishable; a negative-control reported as `identifiable_at_threshold` flags the entire ledger with `negative_control_failed`. Negative-control pairs are excluded from threshold-fitting per the closure plan's negative-control discipline.

mcc_corrected_p_value.description: Multiple-comparison-corrected p-value for the cell, computed via mcc_method.

pre_registered_effect_size_threshold.description: Frozen pre-registered effect-size threshold for the cell's mechanism.

mde_precondition_status.description: Pre-roster minimum-detectable-effect status. `mde_insufficient` cells whose verdict is `identifiable_at_threshold` trigger `identifiability_claim_underpowered`.
